GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 383.7 (7 Dec 45) CIS
(SCAPIN - 400)
APO 500
7 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Naval Warrant Officer HORIE, Kiroku.
The Imperial Japanese Government will apprehend Naval Warrant Officer HORIE, Kiroku, and deliver him to the authorities of the Sugamo Prison Camp for incarceration. Warrant Officer HORIE formerly served on Wake Island and was repatriated on the SS Hikawa Maru on 1 November 1945.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
